'''Dekay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Dekay lived on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] where he ran a medium armor-selling business located at the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Gnarls Outpost|training ground]] in the [[Tythonian Gnarls]]<ref name="TOR" />
